comment: Mr. Lorenzo and his course can be summed up with one word: Perfect

Dr. Lorenzo is an excellent professor! Roman art is a complicated subject that is not for everyone, but I really enjoyed it. He gave a lot of heads up for his assignments and quizzes and the expectations were very clear. My only issue is that the end of the semester featured a final paper, a final project, and a final exam all due in the same week.
Awesome guy teaching an overall easy class. Definitely recommend taking this for an Easy A with not too much work

Dr. Lorenzo is new to Richmond, however, he is one of my favorite professors! He is very helpful, gives good discussion filled lectures, and has interesting projects. He is really funny and wants his students to learn, both of which I greatly appreciate. I would recommend this class to everyone I know.
